environmentVariables.name: BITCOMPARE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer API key from https://pro.bitcompare.net/dashboard/keys. Format: ck_live_*. Requires a Pro or Enterprise plan for MCP access.

toolsPreview.name: get_rates
toolsPreview.description: List current rates across providers, optionally filtered by symbol, category, or provider. For "what is the best yield on BTC right now?" style questions, ALWAYS pass category="lending"/"borrowing"/"staking" — an unfiltered call mostly returns spot prices (category="price"), not yields.

toolsPreview.name: get_rate_by_symbol
toolsPreview.description: Fetch all provider rates for a specific coin symbol. Optionally filter by category — pass category="lending"/"borrowing"/"staking" for yield questions, since unfiltered results mix in spot prices (category="price").

toolsPreview.name: get_rate_history
toolsPreview.description: Historical rate timeseries for a symbol. Recent history (~30 days) is per-tick; older history is daily granularity. Depth is clamped to your plan (up to 365 days on Pro) and bounded by how far back data has been recorded. (Current plan: up to 1825 days of history.)

toolsPreview.name: list_providers
toolsPreview.description: All rate providers, optionally filtered by product category.

toolsPreview.name: get_coin
toolsPreview.description: Full metadata for a coin: description, links, categories, market data, developer stats.

toolsPreview.name: list_coins
toolsPreview.description: Paginated list of coins with optional name/symbol search.

toolsPreview.name: top_coins
toolsPreview.description: Top N coins ordered by market capitalisation.

toolsPreview.name: similar_coins
toolsPreview.description: Coins related to the given coin by category/sector similarity.

toolsPreview.name: coin_history
toolsPreview.description: Historical price timeseries for a coin. (Current plan: up to 1825 days of history.)

toolsPreview.name: get_price
toolsPreview.description: Current aggregated price for one or more symbols, computed from multiple exchange feeds.

toolsPreview.name: get_price_by_symbol
toolsPreview.description: Aggregated exchange price for one symbol, plus the raw per-provider prices that fed the aggregate. Use get_price for multiple symbols in one call.

toolsPreview.name: market_summary
toolsPreview.description: One-call summary of total market cap, 24h volume, BTC/ETH dominance, and recent trend.

toolsPreview.name: fear_greed_index
toolsPreview.description: Current Fear & Greed index value and historical trend.

toolsPreview.name: top_movers
toolsPreview.description: Biggest 24h gainers and losers within a rank segment.

toolsPreview.name: stablecoin_index
toolsPreview.description: Ranked stablecoin leaderboard with stability scores, peg deviation, and market cap.

toolsPreview.name: stablecoin_peg_stability
toolsPreview.description: Peg deviation history and stability stats for a stablecoin.

toolsPreview.name: resolve_symbol
toolsPreview.description: Map an exchange-specific or ambiguous symbol to bitcompare's canonical coin id. Useful when an exchange uses a non-standard ticker.

toolsPreview.name: resolve_symbols_batch
toolsPreview.description: Resolve up to 100 symbols in a single request. Requires a plan with bulk endpoints enabled.
